reason: B better addresses the stated limitations by using a low-thermal-load deposition route that can produce a homogeneous nanocrystalline layer while preserving bulk TC4, and it explicitly tests adhesion, delamination, interfacial phases, hardness, and wear. A largely reuses the already problematic laser-cladding route, treats parameter optimization as resolving cracks and residual stress, and proposes a four-component “HEA” with a physically weak claim that lattice distortion generates reinforcing secondary phases.
